verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows LM Studio is installed via a simple downloadable app across Windows, macOS, and Linux (comm-3, comm-5, comm-10) rather than being built from source, and docs describe a headless 'llmster' package for servers/CI (lm-studio-docs-8) implying additional prebuilt distribution formats. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of installer/package formats (e.g., .exe/.dmg/.deb) and confirmation of robust Linux packaging, since one community report calls Linux support poor (lm-studio-comm-2).
